Blɔ nɔ nɛ wa maa gu kɛ je bumi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ wa nyɛmimɛ Kristofohi ke a mwɔ yi mi kpɔ ko nɛ wa kplɛɛ we nɔ.
Ke O Kɛ Nɔ Ko Kpa We Gbi
hypothesis: Kɛ okɛno kpe pawi gbɛ

reference: Ke wa na kaa nɔ ko ngɛ nɔ́ ko pee nɛ ma ha nɛ e pee yayami nɛ hɛdɔ ngɛ he
hypothesis: Aka nlooko nooko pe nɛ ma hane ipi a yamine he dɔŋne hi.

reference: Mɛni be nɛ e sa nɛ waa tu munyu?
hypothesis: Bɔ nɛ sa nɛ waa tɔmũ nyu.

reference: Anɛ yi mi kpɔ nɛ e mwɔ ɔ maa ye lɛ awi, aloo imi nɛ i ngɛ susue kaa nɔ́ yaya ko maa je mi kɛ ba lo?
hypothesis: Anee imi pɔnee hiɛmɔɔ ma yi la wi, aloo imi nɛɛ ngɛ susuee kaa, noeyaa kɔɔ ma jemika balo.

reference: NƆ́ NƐ MAA YE BUA WƆ NƐ WA JE BUMI KPO KƐ TSƆƆ NI KPAHI KE A MWƆ YI MI KPƆ KO
Ke o le laami sane komɛ nɛ kɔɔ asafo ɔ he
hypothesis: Oli lami sane ko ne ko asafowi. Wang eno tsai.

reference: E sa nɛ asafo mi nikɔtɔmahi kɛ tsui si tomi nɛ wo nihi ga ngɛ be nɛ sa mi
hypothesis: Anɛ asafo nikotomahi kɛ tsu tsɔmi nɛ wɔni nga ngɛ Benɛ Sami

reference: Koo Kojo Ni Kpahi Ngɛ Yi Mi Kpɔ Nɛ A Maa Mwɔ ɔ He
hypothesis: Lala faka keke nyikma kɛ tɛn. Wa ngɛ tue mijɔmi.

reference: Mɛni be nɛ e sa nɛ waa pee dii?
MƐNI HE JE NƐ E SƐ NƐ WAA KOJO NI KPAHI KE A MWƆ YI MI KPƆ KO?
hypothesis: Mni he je nɛɛ sɛni wa kɔ joni kpaŋ ke amɔyim pɔko

reference: Mɛni o kase ngɛ Baiblo mi nɔ hyɛmi níhi nɛ wa susu he ɔ mi?
Ke nihi ngɛ hlae nɛ o tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ a tsi a nya ngɛ ma kpahi a nɔ ɔ guɔ kɛ tsuɔ fiɛɛmi ní tsumi ɔ
Mɛni ní kpakpahi lɛ ma nyɛ maa je yi mi kpɔ nɛ e mwɔ ɔ mi kɛ ba?
hypothesis: Mɛni ni kpaipai lɛmɛ nɛ mɛ jeyi mpo ni emu mika ba.

reference: KƐ YEHOWA NAA NÍHI NƐ WA DEƆ Ɔ HA KƐƐ?
hypothesis: mɛnɛ ni ne wɔadi ha kɛ
